newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan trading firms to provide loan to Petrobras.
newsitem.headline: Japan trading firms to provide loan to Petrobras.

text.p: Three major Japanese trading firms will lend a total of $195 million to Brazil's state oil monopoly Petrobras to construct an oil production platform, a spokesman for one of the companies said on Tuesday.

An agreement for the 11-year loan was signed on Monday in Brazil between Petrobras (Petroleo Brasileiro SA) and Japanese trading firms Marubeni Corp, Sumitomo Corp and Kanematsu Corp, a Marubeni spokesman said.
The platform will be constructed in an oil field some 100 kilometres off the coast of Rio de Janeiro, he said.
Marubeni will provide about $85 million of the loan, Sumitomo about $60 million and Kanematsu $50 million, the spokesman said.
Petrobras has previously said that it aims to increase its crude output to 1.5 million barrels-per-day in the year 2000.
The company ended last year with an average daily production of slightly over 800,000 barrels.
